notes.title: PLANETA 55 IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Planeta 55 is finally out!

Surrealism, horror, action, sci-fi, guns, blood, bosses, a Space Pug, it's all available now!

Play the new Planeta 55

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324750/Planeta_55/

Thank you for your support and please enjoy!

notes.title: News from the development of Planeta 55
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
The development of Planeta 55 is still not at the end but it is getting closer and closer to completion every day. Today I'm here to share some new pictures from the development of Planeta 55! The game is quite a big project at this point and there's a lot to see.

Planeta 55 is a horror-themed fast action sci-fi FPS. Hordes of monsters. New weaponry. Guns. Blood. Fight.
